context: Two teens recap the school week
purpose: Teach: いままで/スッキリ/ヒマ/居心地/悲しく/全開/鳴らし/立ち上がり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今週、いままで体験した中で一番忙しかった。
lines.en: This week was the busiest I've ever been, hands down.
lines.style: Heavy exhale at the start. Flat, matter-of-fact delivery. No drama—just stating fact. Voice drops slightly at the end like she's already moved on.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 授業全開で、ヒマな時間ゼロだよな。
lines.en: Classes back-to-back, literally no breathing room.
lines.style: Nod in the voice. Quick, efficient agreement. Keeps pace light and steady. No complaint in it—just acknowledgment between people who get it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活の鳴らしものパート、立ち上がり練習がきつかった。
lines.en: The percussion warm-ups were actually brutal—my arms were screaming.
lines.style: Sudden brightness breaking through. Picks up speed and volume on 'brutal.' Physical energy in the shoulders. Slight laugh underneath, like she's surprised at herself for surviving it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 居心地はよかったよな、皆で頑張った感じで。
lines.en: But honestly, the atmosphere was really good—felt like we all showed up for it.
lines.style: Softer landing. Genuine warmth, no performance. Slower pace. Settles into the thought like she's noticing it as she says it. Slight nod at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験結果、ちょっと悲しくなったけど、深呼吸でスッキリした。
lines.en: My test score stung a little, but I took a beat and let it go.
lines.style: Quiet, honest admission. Slight hesitation on 'stung.' Then a shift—voice steadies, becomes slightly lighter. Controlled exhale on the final words. No self-pity, just clarity.
